sections.description:
BANKING COMPANIES (PESHAWAR HIGH COURT)
BANKING COMPANIES (PESHAWAR HIGH COURT) RULES, 1972
[Gazette of N.‑W. F. P., Part IV, 5th July 1974]
No. 15‑J.‑In
exercise of powers conferred under section 79 of the Banking Companies
Ordinance, 1962 (Ordinance LVII of 1962), the Chief Justice and Judges,
Peshawar High Court, Peshawar have been pleased to make the following Rules :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑These Rules shall be cited as the
Banking Companies (Peshawar High Court) Rules, 1972 and shall come into force
at once.
2. Interpretation.‑In these Rules, unless the context or subject‑matter
otherwise requires :‑
(1) The 'Ordinance' means the
Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962.
(2) `Certified' means in
relation to a copy certified as provided in section 76 of the Evidence Act,
1872 (Act I of 1872).
(3) 'Code' means the Code of
Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act I of 1908).
(4) `Court' means the Peshawar
High Court, Peshawar.
(5) `Registrar' means the
Registrar of the Court and includes the Assistant Registrar.
(6) `State Bank' means the State
Bank of Pakistan and includes its branches.
(7) 'Sealed' means sealed with
the seal of the Court.
Save as aforesaid, the General
Clauses Act, 1897 (Act X of 1897) shall apply for the interpretation of these
Rules as it applies for the interpreta?tion of an Act of Parliament.
3. Practice and Procedure of the Court and provisions of the Code to
apply.‑The provisions of the Code and Rules of the Court shall apply to
all proceedings under the Ordinance save and to the extent to which they are
inconsistent with the provisions of the Ordinance or these Rules.
4. Registers to be kept.‑For the purposes of proceedings under
the Ordinance and these Rules, there shall be kept, in the Court, the following
Registers and each Register shall contain such particulars and shall be
maintained by such Officer as hereinafter indicated :‑
(1) Banking Company Petition
Register to be maintained by the Assistant Registrar in which all the petitions
filed under the Ordinance and these Rules shall be entered with particulars as
to‑
(i) Date of presentation; (ii)
Name of Banking Company;
(iii) Name of parties and their
Advocates;
(iv) Provisions of Law under
which the petition is made ; (v) Nature of relief sought;
(vi) Date and nature of order
made;
(vii) Date of filing of appeal,
if any;
(viii) Date of disposal of
appeal ; and,
(ix) Result of judgment in
appeal.
(2) Banking Company Application
Register to be maintained by the Assistant Registrar in which all applications
shall be entered and numbered serially with particulars as to‑
(i) Date of presentation;
(ii) Name of Banking Company;
(iii) Number of main
proceedings, if any, to which application relates;
(iv) Name of parties and their
Advocates ;
(v) Provision of Law, if any,
under which the application is made;
(vi) Nature of relief sought;
(vii) Date and nature of order
made;
(viii) Date of filing of
appeal, if any;
(ix) Date of disposal of
appeal; and
(x) Result of judgment in
appeal.
(3) Appearance Book to be
maintained by the Registrar in which shall be entered the appearances filed by
or on behalf of any creditor or contributory.
(4) Liquidation Register shall
be maintained by Liquidator in which shall be entered Banking Company‑wise,
under a separate heading for each Company ordered to be wound up, briefly in
chronological order, all proceedings in winding up until conclusion of the
winding up.
(5) Banking Company Documents
Register to be maintained by the Liquidator in which shall be entered under
separate heading for each Banking Company any valuable securities such as
negotiable instruments, documents of title and the like that may be filed in
proceedings before the Court.
(6) Register of Expedited
Petitions to be maintained by the Assistant Registrar in respect of claims made
by or against any Banking Company in liquidation including claims by or against
any of its branches in Pakistan referred to in section 61 of the Ordinance.
